senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. אַלְוָא) the herbaceous plant aloe, a kind of cress.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:2:7">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:12">Tosef. ib. I</cite>, end (ed. Zuck. <he>עלוא׳</he>, oth. ed. <he>עלויין</he>, <he>עלווין</he>) <he>ומקיימין את הא׳ וכ׳</he> you may (in the Sabbath year) let the aloe grow on the top of the roof, but you must not water it.
